page.layout: One printed page. Top: running head with page number at upper left. Below: two engraved oval portraits in a framed plate (left oval empty, right oval with portrait), with their inscriptions around the ovals. Under the plate: a four-line verse in italic, centred. Then running text in italic in paragraphs, with a list of three names in braces, and a closing word "Omnes" at the right.

l.i: Nos quoque crudeli germanos impiùs hausit-
Albano mandante furor, quos Geldria felix-
Antiqua de stirpe tulit: sed nauta scelestus-
Petrus Dandelot, Philippus à Wingele, Maximilianus
Coccius, ex Geldria Comitis Egmondani nobilis, Philippus
Tristanus à Gandavo, Ioannes à Bloys dictus Treslong,
Bartholomeus de Val, tres quoque primarij è Frisia
Iacobus ab Vlpendam, Ferdinandus Peletier, Constan-
tinus de Bruffelles, Maior Hobokensis, Ioannes de
Philippus Daelts fratres, & Artus de Batson cubicularius

page.notes: Portrait inscriptions: left oval "GISBERTVS BARO BATENBVRGICVS" (oval empty); right oval "THEODERICVS BARO BATENBVRGICVS, Aetatis XXII". Greek and Latin letters in the verse and list are printed with heavy ink and some damage; the word "impiùs" and "arena" are read with some doubt, and the text in the upper left of the left oval is show-through and not transcribed.
